title: A second friend with the same name earns the member no free days, yet the screen says they were added
what: When a member brings two friends who have the same name, the owner’s tap for the second friend adds no days to the member’s plan. The screen still says the free days were added and shows a new end date, and the offer is closed for good.
expected: Each friend who joins gives the member the free days once; the already-given check should look at this friend’s own enquiry, not at the friend’s name.
who: owners and the members who invite friends
how_often: whenever one member brings two friends with the same name (also across old plans)
fix_line: Tie the already-given check to the friend’s enquiry, not the name
